name: 到期管家
description: Track recurring due dates and Apple Reminders with compact widgets, safe completion history, local backups, optional notifications, and checked updates.

localizedDescriptions.en: 2.5.7 fixes mixed Wallet Plan lists being forced to one credit-card icon. Wallet Plan is now a neutral container; within it, strict numbered prefixes such as BANK, CREDIT, POINTS, INVEST, LOAN, INSURANCE, TAX, BILL and PAYMENT, plus specific titles and high-confidence note hints, resolve each item independently. Credit-monitoring services such as Equifax also receive a distinct document-search icon. Existing items and widget layouts are unchanged.
localizedDescriptions.zh: 2.5.7 修复 Wallet Plan 混合列表全部被识别为信用卡的问题。Wallet Plan 改为中性容器；在该 List 内，BANK、CREDIT、POINTS、INVEST、LOAN、INSURANCE、TAX、BILL、PAYMENT 等严格编号前缀、具体标题与高置信度备注会为每条事项独立推断。Equifax 等信用监控服务也使用独立的文档查询图标。已有事项与组件排版不变。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 2.5.7 修复 Wallet Plan 混合列表全部被识别为信用卡的问题。Wallet Plan 改为中性容器；在该 List 内，BANK、CREDIT、POINTS、INVEST、LOAN、INSURANCE、TAX、BILL、PAYMENT 等严格编号前缀、具体标题与高置信度备注会为每条事项独立推断。Equifax 等信用监控服务也使用独立的文档查询图标。已有事项与组件排版不变。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hant: 2.5.7 修復 Wallet Plan 混合清單全部被識別為信用卡的問題。Wallet Plan 改為中性容器；在該 List 內，BANK、CREDIT、POINTS、INVEST、LOAN、INSURANCE、TAX、BILL、PAYMENT 等嚴格編號前綴、具體標題與高置信度備註會為每條事項獨立推斷。Equifax 等信用監控服務也使用獨立的文件查詢圖示。現有事項與元件排版不變。
